I found Frank's body in electrical just now. My route was security → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical, doing tasks along the way. The only player I saw the whole round was Alice — she was in security at tick 3 and 4, and I noticed she came into security from electrical at tick 3. That's suspicious given where I found Frank. Bob and Charlie, I need to hear your routes — especially if either of you was near electrical or weapons (since Diana is also dead). Alice is my early suspect.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical → medbay → storage → medbay → cafeteria, doing tasks along the way.

Here's what I saw: I was in electrical from around tick 6 to 9 doing my task. Diana was there with me from tick 6 to 7, then she left electrical heading toward security at tick 8. Frank came into electrical around tick 7 and was still there at tick 9 — alive when I left. At tick 9, Charlie entered electrical from medbay just as I was leaving. So Charlie was the last person I saw with Frank in electrical.

Then I went to storage via medbay, and at tick 14 I saw Alice enter storage from navigation, not from electrical. She was with me in storage at ticks 14 and 15.

This contradicts Eve's story a bit — Eve said Alice came into security from electrical at tick 3, but I saw Alice coming from navigation into storage at tick 14. That's possible if Alice moved around a lot, but more importantly: **Charlie entered electrical right as Frank was there and I was leaving.** Charlie hasn't spoken yet — I really want to hear his route. Right now Charlie is my top suspect, not Alice.

My route was electrical → security → navigation → storage. I want to address Eve's accusation directly: yes, I was in electrical at the start of the round, then moved to security at tick 3 where I saw Eve at ticks 3 and 4. From security I went to navigation, then to storage, where I met Bob at tick 14. Bob then left storage toward medbay at tick 15. So Bob's account of seeing me enter storage from navigation matches my route exactly — that's a mutual alibi for that timeframe.

Importantly, I left electrical very early — around tick 2-3 — well before Frank was killed there. Bob says Frank was alive in electrical at tick 9 when Charlie entered. That timeline clears me from the electrical kill entirely.

Bob's story and mine line up cleanly. Eve's accusation against me is technically true that I was in electrical early, but it ignores that Frank was alive there much later with Bob and then Charlie. Charlie being the last person seen with Frank in electrical is the most damning lead we have.

Charlie, we need to hear your route. Right now my vote is leaning Charlie unless he has a strong explanation.

Okay, I need to address this directly because Bob's framing makes me sound bad, but the timeline actually works in my favor if you listen carefully.

My route was: navigation → storage → medbay → electrical → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation, doing tasks along the way.

Yes, I entered electrical around tick 9-10, and Bob was leaving as I arrived. Frank was there — **alive** — when I got there. I did a quick task and left electrical back through medbay heading to cafeteria. Frank was still alive when I left. So if Bob is telling the truth that Frank was alive at tick 9 when he left, and I'm telling the truth that Frank was alive when I left around tick 10-11, then someone ELSE entered electrical after me and killed Frank.

Here's the important part: at tick 15, I was in **weapons**, and I saw **Diana there**. Diana is now dead. Weapons connects to cafeteria and security. After weapons I went to security, then navigation. So Diana was killed in or near weapons after I left — and whoever was moving through that corridor is a suspect for her death.

Now think about this: Eve's route ends at electrical where she "found" Frank. Eve claims she was doing a long loop, but she conveniently arrives at electrical to report right after the kills happen. Bob and Alice have a mutual alibi in storage at tick 14-15, which is fine. But Eve is the one with no one vouching for her in the late game, and she's the reporter.

I think Eve is fishing by pinning this on me because I'm the easy "last seen with Frank" target. But Frank was alive when I left. My vote is Eve.

Okay, I've heard everyone. Let me respond.

First, Charlie — I'm not "fishing." I reported because I literally just walked into electrical and found Frank's body. That's what you're supposed to do. The fact that I'm the reporter doesn't make me the killer; it makes me the person who found the body.

Second, on the timeline: Bob says Frank was alive at tick 9 when Charlie entered. Charlie says Frank was alive when he left around tick 10-11. I arrived at electrical at tick 19 — that's an 8-9 tick window where someone could have come in and killed Frank. So the question is: who was unaccounted for during ticks 11-18?

Bob and Alice vouch for each other in storage at ticks 14-15. That's a partial alibi but doesn't cover the full window. Charlie claims he went electrical → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation, and saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 15. Diana is now dead too — and Charlie is the one who places himself near her last.

Here's what bothers me about Charlie's story: he's the last to see Frank alive AND the last to see Diana alive, by his own admission. Two victims, both with Charlie nearby right before death. That's a lot of coincidence.

I'll walk back my Alice accusation — Bob's storage sighting corroborates her. My vote is leaning Charlie.

I want to weigh in again since I have the most direct info on the electrical timeline.

To recap what I actually witnessed: Diana left electrical toward security at tick 8 — alive. Frank was alive in electrical at tick 9 when I left and Charlie entered. So between Charlie and Eve, one of them is lying about Frank's state.

Charlie says Frank was alive when he left electrical around tick 10-11. That's plausible but unverifiable — I didn't see him leave. What I can say is Charlie was definitely alone with Frank in electrical after I left.

Charlie's counter-argument about Diana is interesting though. He says he saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 15. I can't verify that, but I can verify Diana left electrical toward security at tick 8 — so her path could plausibly have taken her to weapons later. If Charlie is telling the truth about seeing Diana in weapons at 15, then someone else killed her after.

Here's my problem with Eve's logic: she's right that there's a window from tick 11-18 where someone could have killed Frank. But Eve herself is unaccounted for by any witness during that window. Her whole route is self-reported with zero corroboration — she claims she saw Alice in security early, but no one else places her anywhere until she reports.

I'm torn between Charlie and Eve. Charlie has opportunity on Frank (alone with him). Eve has no alibi for the kill window and is the reporter. Alice and I have a mutual alibi for ticks 14-15.

I'm leaning Charlie slightly because the "alone with the victim" evidence is concrete, but I want to hear if anyone can corroborate ANY part of Eve's route before I commit. Right now my vote is Charlie, but I could be swayed.

I've already laid out my route and Bob has corroborated my storage alibi at ticks 14-15. Let me focus on the decision between Charlie and Eve since that's where this is heading.

Charlie was alone with Frank in electrical — that's opportunity. But he's also volunteering specific details: that Frank was alive when he left, that he saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 15. Those are checkable claims that a Duck wouldn't necessarily make because they create contradictions if false.

Eve's route, as Bob pointed out, is entirely self-reported. She places me in security at ticks 3 and 4 — which is true, I was there and saw her too. So that part of her route checks out. But everything after that is uncorroborated until she reports Frank's body at tick 19.

Here's what tips me: Eve initially accused me based on me being in electrical early, even though Frank was clearly killed much later. That's either sloppy analysis or deliberate misdirection to burn a meeting on the wrong target. A Goose reporter usually says "I found the body, here's my route, I don't know who did it." Eve came in hot with an accusation that didn't hold up to the timeline.

Combined with Eve having no alibi for the 11-18 kill window, I'm voting Eve. Charlie's story is consistent and falsifiable; Eve's is convenient and accusatory.

My vote is Eve.

Thanks Alice — and I want to second your reasoning because it matches what I've been thinking.

Quick recap of my position: I entered electrical at tick 10, Bob was leaving, Frank was alive. I did a brief task and left through medbay to cafeteria, then weapons at tick 15 where I saw Diana alive, then security, then navigation where I was when the meeting was called. Frank and Diana were both alive when I last saw them.

Eve's logic has a hole that's bugging me. She said the kill window for Frank is ticks 11-18. That's a long window. During that time, Bob and Alice corroborate each other in storage at 14-15. I was in cafeteria/weapons/security in the second half of that window — and I saw Diana alive in weapons at 15, which means I was actively moving through the top-right of the map, nowhere near electrical after tick 11.

Who does that leave for the back half of the kill window with no corroboration? Eve. Her entire late route — oxygen, upper engine, medbay, electrical — passes right through the rooms where both kills could have originated. And she "happens" to arrive at electrical to find the body she's perfectly positioned to have created.

Also worth noting: Eve opened the meeting with a confident accusation against Alice that fell apart the moment Bob spoke. That's classic Duck behavior — throw out a target early to control the narrative, then pivot when it doesn't stick. She's now pivoted to me.

My vote is Eve.
